origin.note: Golden Gate 27.0 (26A428) and Tahoe lack the rule; 27.2 (26B123) and later have it

args.text:
;;; Disk space reporting ({,f}statfs(), getattrlist() ATTR_VOL_SPACE*)
(allow system-info
       (info-type "vfs.disk-space"))

edits.reason: the Darwin 27 kernel asks the Sandbox about disk-space info; without macOS 27.2's rule every (deny default) profile that imports system.sb denies and reports each statfs/getattrlist call
edits.evidence: 26B123's system.sb is 26A428's plus exactly this block (src/disk_space_rule.py)
